title: 2.2 Trends in Global Climate Change
description: Observed warming, greenhouse gas records, IPCC assessments and temperature projections. Hard level.

questions.question: Why is the 1951 to 1980 base period important in the temperature index?
options: It provides the reference against which temperature changes are measured
Subduction of one oceanic plate beneath another builds volcanic islands
Direct measurements made at locations on the atmosphere, land and oceans
Net greenhouse gas emissions offset by activities such as planting trees
questions.correctAnswer: It provides the reference against which temperature changes are measured

questions.question: What does the 0.8 degrees Celsius and 0.6 degrees Celsius comparison suggest?
options: An increase of 1.4 to 5.8 degrees Celsius
The two figures are contradictory
Oceans absorb more heat and become warmer
Warming has accelerated in recent decades
questions.correctAnswer: Warming has accelerated in recent decades

questions.question: What follows from rising carbon dioxide, methane and nitrous oxide in ice cores?
options: Convergence, subduction, melting, magma rise, volcano
Human activities have altered atmospheric composition
Mountain belts formed independently on each continent
A ridge forms on land; a rift forms only in the ocean
questions.correctAnswer: Human activities have altered atmospheric composition

questions.question: Why is the 1998 warm-year finding significant?
options: Adaptation that takes place after initial impacts have occurred
They address different parts of the problem: causes and impacts
It was the warmest in the instrumental record beginning in 1861
Local variations can mislead; the global mean reveals the trend
questions.correctAnswer: It was the warmest in the instrumental record beginning in 1861

questions.question: What does the 1.4 to 5.8 degrees Celsius projection depend on?
options: A cooler, darker magnetic storm region on the Sun
Whether greenhouse gas emissions continue to rise
The distribution of fossils and the ages of rocks
They proved a volcanic origin for both continents
questions.correctAnswer: Whether greenhouse gas emissions continue to rise

questions.question: Which evidence combination makes the case for climate change strongest?
options: Adaptation that takes place after initial impacts have occurred
They store carbon and support economic and ecological functions
It was the warmest in the instrumental record beginning in 1861
Atmosphere, land and ocean observations together with ice cores
questions.correctAnswer: Atmosphere, land and ocean observations together with ice cores

questions.question: What does a collective picture of a warming world imply?
options: It releases additional carbon dioxide into the atmosphere
Many independent observations point in the same direction
They have moved relative to each other over geologic time
It may shrink to less than 10 percent of the Arctic Ocean
questions.correctAnswer: Many independent observations point in the same direction

questions.question: How would you describe the claim about the twentieth century?
options: Reduce greenhouse gas emissions and enhance sinks
It was likely the warmest century in a millennium
It was identical to all previous centuries
It was the coldest century in a millennium
questions.correctAnswer: It was likely the warmest century in a millennium

questions.question: Why use global mean temperature rather than local records?
options: Local variation can be misleading while the global mean shows the trend
Net greenhouse gas emissions offset by activities such as planting trees
Subduction of one oceanic plate beneath another builds volcanic islands
Direct measurements made at locations on the atmosphere, land and oceans
questions.correctAnswer: Local variation can be misleading while the global mean shows the trend

questions.question: Which statement about the IPCC 2001 report is accurate?
options: It is a market mechanism agreed in the Bonn Agreements to help meet targets
They are interdependent, so a change in one place leads to changes elsewhere
It documented the warmest decade and warmest year in the instrumental record
It raises farm productivity and income while cutting agricultural emissions
questions.correctAnswer: It documented the warmest decade and warmest year in the instrumental record
